exposure: Bilateral Pomeroy tubal ligation performed during cesarean section
cohort: The study included 130 patients who underwent bilateral Pomeroy tubal ligation during a cesarean section.
finding: The Pomeroy ligation technique demonstrated a 99% contraceptive success rate with no complications at 6 months, and a 1% technique failure resulting in intrauterine pregnancy within 1 year.
mod_finding: The study specifically investigates the contraceptive effectiveness of Pomeroy tubal ligation when performed concurrently with a cesarean section.
